```{r}
AR_est = function(Y, param){
  l = length(Y)
  phis = rep(0, param)
  sigma = 1
  
  ML = function(vector_param, Y){
    l2 = length(vector_param) - 1
    result = 1
    
    for(n in l2:l){
      Ys = Y[(n - l2):n]*vector_param[-(l2+1)]
      result = result*dnorm(sum(Ys), mean = 0, sd = vector_param[l2+1])
    }
    return(-result)
  }
  
  estimate = optim(c(phis, sigma), ML, Y = Y, method = "BFGS")
  return(estimate)
}
```

```{r}
serie = arima.sim(list(1,0,0), 300)

AR_est(serie, 2)
```
